record.field: Work logs or timesheets missing from the payslip
Approved work logs or payable timesheets are not in these draft payslips. Compute them again before validating; an edited payslip must be cancelled and replaced.
danger
python

payslips = self.env['hr.payslip'].search([ ('state', '=', 'draft'), ('company_id', 'in', self.env.companies.ids), ('struct_id.country_id', '=', self.country_id.id), ] + ([('id', 'in', records.ids)] if records else [])) warning_records = payslips._gec_unclaimed_slips()
